pages.text: Returns the day of the week, from 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday).$(br2)Without $(1)time$() the function uses the current time. It uses the time zone of the server.
$(li)$(1)time$() TIME: the time (optional, default now)$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: the day of the week, 1 to 7
$(1)CALL c0de/time/WEEKDAY$(br)  PARAMETER time t ;$(br)  RESULT result weekday$()
